doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Milton Shots at the Kingfish firing and rehiring Billie
summary: Billie tells how the Kingfish owner fired her, how she nearly quit over no rests, and the low pay.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Who was shot you talking about? The King?
Milton Shots. Milton Shots. Milton Shots. Milton Shots. Was he the King Fish? Yeah. Yeah, he was the King Fish.
Oh, I see.
Oh, I see.
And he's the one that fired you, huh?
Yeah, and hired me back. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He hired me back. I didn't care. I go right next door, go to the job. Get a job. You never have one right, I get a job.
He and Vincent La Presto in Italian. No, no, no, that's a serial. Serial, I meant to say. That's a serial. They were in partnership. They were in partnership. It was partnership.
Italian and Jew.
Jew and Italian.

I'm telling you. It was a combination. The Jew trying to out-beat the Italian, I tell you not to beat the Jew. You know, it was a scratch, you know. It was a scratch, understand? It was a combination, right? Yeah.
I'm telling you.
You can get some kick out.
A lot of fun out there with him. I don't like shit.
Well, let's get that story down about him firing you again.

And just fire me, because I just told him that- I told him that- I was, I believe it wasn't. No, he didn't want to give me a chance to rest. Oh, that's what, yeah. Every time- It was wasted and legit then.
Every time the band was stopped.
He would pat, he'd get on the back, he's a bar, he'd want to get on the back and-
You said, I'm gonna quit. That's where that went. Yeah. And he said, what you said, Bill? Bill said, come here, I'll tell you what I said.
He said, what you said? I said, come here, I'll tell you exactly what I said. I said, you keep on, I said, I'm gonna quit.
You can't quit your father.

You can't quit. You can't quit now, you wouldn't pay much money, no, huh? You can't quit now. And I don't point it about two o'clock, I gotta go to three. And I know if I quit then, I had a little dollar, quarter, two dollars a head, whatever it was, come here tell me, the money that they was paid was nothing, you know? And so I said, well, I'll just go ahead and make the night on out. I said, well, you get somebody, cause I done quit.
You quit too? I said, no. I quit.
Me and McGee quit. We didn't care. Go somewhere. I know, go somewhere. I got to go.
Job, pay for that time.
You ain't no way to get a job.
I mean, it was a lively spot for tips. Yeah, we made nice stuff.
We made nice stuff. Oh, we made nice stuff. I played you be like sardines in a can in there. I stayed.
